_meta.description: Complete config schema for PressGo page generation. This is the exact structure the AI must produce. The PHP generator consumes this config dict to build Elementor JSON.

config_structure._note: Top-level config is a flat dict. Required keys: colors, fonts, layout, sections. Each section listed in 'sections' array must have a matching top-level key with its config.

colors._description: Color palette for the entire page. The generator auto-derives primary_dark, primary_light, accent, text_light, gold, border if omitted.

primary.description: Main brand color — buttons, accents, links, highlights

dark_bg.description: Dark background — hero, results, dark sections

light_bg.description: Light background — features, steps, faq sections

white.description: White — cards, light text on dark

primary_light.description: Light tint of primary for backgrounds

theme.description: Set to 'dark' for a FULL-DARK page (premium gym/studio/luxury look): every section renders on dark surfaces, cards become frosted translucent panels, hardcoded light strips are auto-remapped. When using it ALSO set: light_bg = a dark tint (e.g. #15181D), text_dark = a light hex (#F2F2F2), text_muted = light rgba. Zero light strips — contrast comes from photos and frosted cards.

fonts._description: Typography pairing (Google Font family names). Pick a distinct heading + body that fit the brand and vary across builds. NEVER use Inter for BOTH heading and body — that is the #1 generic-template tell. A characterful heading (serif or distinctive sans) over a clean body reads designed.

heading.description: Font for all headings (h1-h6). e.g. Playfair Display, Poppins, DM Serif Display, Space Grotesk, Work Sans, Fraunces

body.description: Font for body text. e.g. Source Sans Pro, Inter, Karla, Nunito Sans, Roboto, Mulish

layout._description: Global layout settings. All have sensible defaults.

section_padding.description: Vertical padding for sections in px

card_radius.description: Border radius for cards in px

button_radius.description: Border radius for buttons in px

layout._note_2_4: NEW: section_divider: 'waves'|'tilt'|'curve'|'triangle' adds native shape dividers between flat color seams (divider color auto-matches the next section). section_padding scales density (50=compact ... 150=airy).

sections.description: Ordered list of section names to render. Determines page order. REPETITION: a section type may appear more than once by suffixing repeats with #2, #3 in order of appearance (["hero","gallery","gallery#2"]). The suffixed name is BOTH the sections entry and the top-level data key ("gallery#2": {...}). The first instance is never suffixed; #1 is illegal. Suffixed instances take the same fields and variants as the base type. Never repeat hero or footer.

hero._description: The first section visitors see. ALWAYS include a hero.

variant.description: Layout variant. Omit for default (centered text on dark gradient).

options.default: Centered text on dark gradient background. Bold, impactful. Best for SaaS, tech, bold messaging.
options.split: Text left + image right on light background. Professional, informative. Best for services, products, SaaS.
options.image: Full background image with dark overlay. Dramatic, immersive. Best for hospitality, real estate, events.
options.video: Centered text + video embed on light background. Engaging. Best for courses, demos, creative.
options.gradient: Colorful gradient background with wave divider. Vibrant, playful. Best for creative, startups, apps.
options.minimal: Clean white background, centered text, no gradient. Simple, elegant. Best for portfolio, professional services.
options.mesh: Layered mesh-gradient background built from the brand palette (no image needed). Premium SaaS/studio look. Pairs beautifully with headline_style 'gradient'.
options.split_screen: Full-bleed 50/50: flat primary color panel with copy left, edge-to-edge photo right. REQUIRES a real image URL (falls back to split). Bold, editorial.
options.form: ELEMENTOR PRO ONLY (falls back to default hero on free sites): the classic lead-gen hero — pitch + bullets left, lead form card right, ABOVE the fold. THE local-trade quote-request pattern. Uses hero.form_fields/form_recipient (same shapes as cta_final.form); cta_primary.text becomes the submit label.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase text above headline. e.g. 'AI-POWERED', 'WELCOME TO', '#1 RATED'

headline.description: Main hero headline. Keep under 10 words. High impact.

subheadline.description: Supporting text under headline. 1-2 sentences. Expand on value prop.
subheadline.example: AI-powered page generation that converts visitors into customers.

cta_secondary.description: Secondary/ghost CTA button. Appears next to primary.

badge.description: Small pill badge above eyebrow. e.g. 'NEW', '2026 Launch', 'Beta'

trust_line.description: Small trust text below CTAs. e.g. 'No credit card required', 'Join 10,000+ users'
trust_line.example: Free 14-day trial — No credit card required

image.description: Image URL. Required for 'split' and 'image' variants. Used as background for 'image' variant, right-side for 'split'.

video.description: YouTube or Vimeo URL. Only used by 'video' variant.

meta_items.description: 1-3 inline {icon, text} facts under the subheadline ('fas fa-calendar' + 'Sept 14 · Greer City Park', '4 BD · 3 BA'). For events, real estate, restaurants.

topbar.description: Slim header strip inside the hero: {brand: 'Arbor Nation', phone: '(864) 555-0101', cta: {text:'Free Estimate', url:'#'}}. Brand wordmark left, tap-to-call phone + small accent button right. STRONGLY recommended for local-business landers — every high-converting local page leads with one.

panel.description: 'left' (image variant): anchors the copy stack in a left-aligned dark content panel over a lightly-scrimmed photo — the hand-built local-lander hero look. Pairs with bullets + topbar.

bullets.description: 3-5 short trust bullets under the subheadline ('ISA Certified & TCIA Member','Free written estimates first','24/7 storm response'). Renders as an accent checkmark list. Use on local-service heroes.

options.gradient: Headline renders with a brand gradient fill (background-clip text, safe fallback color). Use on solid/gradient heroes for a premium 2026 look; avoid over photos.

parallax._note: On hero 'image'/'split_screen': background photo scrolls slower than the page (background-attachment fixed; auto-disabled on touch devices).

form_fields._note: Pro 'form' variant only — same shape as cta_final.form_fields.

form_recipient._note: Pro 'form' variant only — leads email here; ONLY if the user gave one (defaults to admin email). NEVER invent.

stats._description: Key metrics/numbers that build credibility. Usually 3-4 items.
stats._note: Config can be {items: [...]} or just a flat array of items. Both work.

options.default: White cards with icons, negative top margin overlapping hero. Best after dark hero.
options.dark: Dark gradient background with colored counters. Best after light sections.
options.inline: Minimal horizontal counter row with dividers. Compact, no cards. Best as accent strip.
options.ticker: Slim full-width accent band with 3-5 inline stats separated by hairlines. Every number must be REAL (user-provided).

items.description: Array of stat items. Ideal count: 3-4.

value.description: The stat number as string. Parser auto-extracts prefix/number/suffix. Examples: '500+', '$2.5M', '99%', '3x', '10K+'

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

social_proof._description: Industry trust indicators. Pill badges showing served industries.

options.default: Light background with pill badges. Standard.
options.dark: Dark background with light pill badges. Use after light hero.

categories.description: Industry/category names shown as pill badges.

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

features._description: Core value proposition. What the product/service offers.

options.default: 3-column icon-box card grid with accent top borders. Classic, versatile. Best for 3 features.
options.alternating: Alternating text/image rows (left-right zigzag). Best for 2-4 features with images.
options.minimal: Clean icons with text, no card backgrounds. Elegant, modern. Best for 3-6 features.
options.image_cards: Image on top of each card. Visual, product-focused. Best for 3 features with photos.
options.grid: 2-column card grid. Best for 4+ features (even numbers).
options.bento: Asymmetric bento grid: one large accent-gradient hero tile beside smaller white tiles, overflow in a 3-up row. Modern SaaS look, no images needed. Best for 4-6 features; the FIRST item becomes the big tile, so make it your strongest. Falls back to the default 3-column card layout below 3 items.
options.tabs: Tabbed services/offerings using native Elementor tabs (becomes a stacked accordion on mobile). Each item: title = tab label, desc (+ optional details[] lines) = tab content. 2-6 tabs.

subheadline.example: Powerful tools designed for modern teams.

items.description: Feature items. Ideal: 3 for default/image_cards, 2-4 for alternating, 4-6 for grid.

image.description: Image URL. Used by alternating and image_cards variants.

accent.description: Custom accent color for this card's top border. Defaults to primary.

link.description: Makes this card clickable: adds a small 'Learn More' button linking here. Accepts a relative path (/intern-program), full URL, mailto:, or tel:. Use this when the user wants cards or buttons connected to pages.

link_text.description: Label for the card's link button. Defaults to 'Learn More'.

price.description: image_cards variant: bold price line above the title ('From $389,900', '$49'). Turns cards into listings/product cards.

meta.description: image_cards variant: small uppercase meta line under the title ('4 BD · 3 BA · 2,400 SQFT').

cta.description: image_cards variant: per-card {text, url} outline button pinned to the card bottom.

background.description: Section background override (default light_bg). Use to alternate dark/tinted strips.

cta.description: Section-closing CTA button {text,url} — repeat the SAME label/tel: as the hero CTA for conversion rhythm on local-service landers.

steps._description: How-it-works process. Step-by-step guide. Usually 3 steps.

options.default: Numbered circles on light background cards. Traditional, clear.
options.compact: Numbered pill badges with connecting divider. Modern, space-efficient.
options.timeline: Vertical timeline with connecting line. Sequential, narrative.
options.editorial: Oversized ghost numerals (01/02/03 at 12% accent opacity) beside title+desc, alternating sides. High-design editorial look for studios/agencies.
options.modules: Course-curriculum module list: numbered module cards with title, desc, and optional per-item `duration` ('3 lessons · 45 min'). For courses, coaching programs, bootcamps.

anchor.description: HTML anchor ID for smooth scrolling.

desc.example: Tell us about your business and what kind of page you need.

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

results._description: Measurable outcomes and impact metrics. Dark background for contrast.

options.default: Dark gradient with animated counter cards. Dramatic, impactful.
options.bars: Light background with bold metric cards (accent top border, animated counters). Clean, data-focused. Values keep their real shape ($2.5M, 340%, 4.9/5) — they are NOT converted to percentages.

description.example: Our clients consistently achieve measurable improvements.

color.description: Accent color for this metric's counter.

competitive_edge._description: Why choose us / differentiators. Benefits checklist with CTA.

options.default: Text + icon-list checklist on light background. Simple, effective.
options.image: Text + checkmarks on left, image on right. Visual proof. Best when photo available.
options.cards: Benefit cards with icons in 3-column grid. Feature-like presentation.
options.comparison: Us-vs-them: muted card with X-marks (them_points + them_label) beside an accented checkmark card (benefits + us_label). The conversion centerpiece for SaaS/services/ecom. REQUIRES them_points; falls back to default checklist without it.

description.example: We combine AI intelligence with proven design patterns.

benefits.description: Benefit statements shown as checkmark list.

image.description: Image URL. Only used by 'image' variant.

them_points.description: For 'comparison': 3-5 pains of the alternative ('Rushed 10-minute consults','Hidden fees'). Honest, not strawman.

us_label.description: Comparison card label — use the business name.

testimonials._description: Customer quotes and social proof from real people.

options.default: 3-column cards with star ratings. Balanced, comprehensive.
options.featured: One large featured quote + smaller cards below. Best when one testimonial stands out.
options.grid: 2-column card grid with avatars. Best for 4+ testimonials.
options.minimal: Editorial spotlight: the FIRST quote runs large with an accent rule, remaining quotes sit smaller in two columns. Elegant, card-free. Lead with your strongest quote.
options.wall: Masonry quote wall (CSS columns: 3/2/1 responsive). The 'wall of love' pattern. Needs 4+ quotes; fewer falls back to grid. Great with mixed-length REAL quotes.

subheadline.example: See what our customers have to say.

items.description: Testimonial items. 3 for default, 3+ for featured (first is featured), 4+ for grid.

quote.example: PressGo cut our page creation time from days to minutes.

aggregate.description: Real aggregate rating shown under the header as stars + '4.9 — 217 Google reviews': {rating: 4.9, count: 217, source: 'Google'}. ONLY with real numbers from the user.

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

faq._description: Frequently asked questions. Uses toggle widget (FREE, not accordion).

options.split: Header/description on left, accordion on right. Spacious, premium feel.

description.description: Description text. Only used by 'split' variant.
description.example: Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team.

cta.description: Optional CTA. Only used by 'split' variant.

a.example: Describe your business and PressGo generates a complete landing page.

blog._description: Recent blog posts grid. REQUIRES Elementor Pro.
blog._note: Only include if the site has Elementor Pro installed.

options.default: Full-width plan cards with feature lists, highlighted plan prominent. Standard.
options.compact: Left-aligned cards, smaller price text, bordered highlight. Modern, restrained.
options.list: Editorial service/menu price list: name left, accent price right, optional desc, grouped by per-item category. THE layout for restaurant menus, salon/spa/barber services, trade rate cards. Uses `items`, not plans. Falls back to plan cards when items missing.
options.donation: Donation tier cards: amount-first display ('$50'), impact line as body, optional badge/highlighted, ALL buttons default to the section-level cta url (one give link powers every tier). For nonprofits, churches, fundraisers. Optional trust_line ('Tax-deductible · EIN ...' — REAL info only).

plans.description: Plan cards. 2-3 plans recommended. One should be highlighted.

price.description: Price as string for flexible formatting.

highlighted.description: Set true for the recommended plan.

compare_at.description: Strikethrough original price above the real price ('$98'). Only when there is a genuine discount.

items.description: For the 'list' variant only: flat list of services/dishes. 4-18 items.

category.description: Group label (e.g. Cuts / Color / Treatments). Items group by category in order of first appearance.

cta.description: Section-level CTA under the price list / plan cards {text,url}.

logo_bar._description: Trusted-by logo row. Shows partner/client logos.

options.default: Light background with grayscale logos. Standard.
options.dark: Dark background with light logos. Use after light section.
options.marquee: Infinite horizontal logo marquee (pure CSS, pauses on hover, respects reduced-motion). Needs 4+ logos/names; fewer falls back to the static row.

logos.description: Logo images. Rendered at fixed size with grayscale filter.

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

team._description: Team member cards with photos, roles, and social links.

options.default: Full cards with photo, name, role, bio, and social links. Comprehensive.
options.compact: Small photos, name + role only, no bio or cards. Space-efficient.
options.spotlight: Editorial single-person profile: photo (or initials circle) left; name, role, bio, credentials checklist, socials, CTA right. For the solo professional who IS the business. AUTO-USED whenever team has exactly 1 member.

members.description: Team members. 3-4 for default, 4-6 for compact.

bio.description: Short bio. Used by default variant only.

credentials.description: Spotlight variant: 2-4 short credentials ('SC Bar 1998','Redken certified').

options.default: Image grid with lightbox. Clean, simple. Configurable columns.
options.cards: 2-column image cards with optional captions. Curated, editorial.
options.before_after: Labeled BEFORE/AFTER photo pairs with optional bold result line + caption. The proof section for transformation businesses (detailing, landscaping, dental, fitness, renovation). REQUIRES real image URLs for both sides of each pair.
options.videos: 2-up grid of video embeds with optional titles/captions. For videographers, musicians, course creators. YouTube/Vimeo URLs only.
options.carousel: Auto-playing image carousel (native swiper, no JS authored). Needs 3+ REAL images; fewer falls back to cards.

images.description: Can be simple URL strings or objects with url/alt/caption.

columns.description: Number of columns. Only used by default variant.

pairs.description: For 'before_after': [{before: url, after: url, result?: '“Lost 32 lbs in 16 weeks”', caption?}]. Max 4 pairs. Pairs missing either real image are dropped.

videos.description: For 'videos': [{url, title?, caption?}] or plain YouTube/Vimeo URL strings. Max 6.

cta.description: Optional section-closing CTA {text,url}. On lead-gen landers repeat the SAME primary CTA (e.g. 'Get My Free Estimate' or tel:) after most sections — CTA rhythm converts.

options.default: Card-style with headline, description, CTA button, and privacy note. Full featured.
options.inline: Gradient bar with headline + button side by side. Compact, eye-catching.

description.default: Get the latest updates delivered to your inbox.

note.description: Privacy note below button. Only used by default variant.
note.example: We respect your privacy. Unsubscribe anytime.

newsletter._note_pro: On Elementor Pro sites, a newsletter whose cta has no real url automatically renders as a WORKING email-capture form (signups email the site admin). Give cta.url only when an external signup page exists.

map._description: Google Maps embed. Good for local businesses, contact pages.

height.description: Map height in px. Mobile auto-scales to 5/8.

options.contact: 'Visit Us' block: contact card (address, tap-to-call phone, email, hours lines, note, CTA) beside the map. The standard local-business contact section. Needs at least one of phone/email/hours; falls back to bare map otherwise.

phone.description: Rendered as a tap-to-call tel: link.

hours.description: One line per range; each gets a clock icon.

note.example: Street parking on Main, lot behind the building.

cta.description: {text, url}. Defaults to a Call Now tel: button when phone is set.

cta_final._description: Final call-to-action before footer. Strong closing push.

options.default: Gradient bar with centered text and button. Bold, high-contrast.
options.card: White card on light background. Elegant, restrained.
options.image: Full background image with dark overlay. Dramatic, immersive.
options.split: Two-column closer: headline + CTA left, frosted checklist card of `bullets` right, on dark bg. Conversion-focused, modern. REQUIRES the bullets array (3-5 short reassurances); without bullets it falls back to default.
options.form: ELEMENTOR PRO ONLY (auto-falls-back on free sites): native lead-capture form as the closer — pitch + trust bullets left, form card right. Fields default name/phone/email/message; customize via form_fields. THE lead-gen closer.

description.example: Join thousands of businesses already using PressGo.

image.description: Background image. Only used by 'image' variant.

bullets.description: Short reassurance bullets for the 'split' variant's checklist card (3-5 items, a few words each: guarantees, turnaround, what's included).

social_icons.description: Social media icons below CTA. Same format as footer social_icons.

cta_secondary.description: Optional second (outline) button beside the primary — 'View menu' beside 'Book now'. {text, url, icon?}.

form_fields._note: Pro form variant only. [{label, type: text|tel|email|textarea|select, options?: [...], required?, width?: '50'|'100'}], max 7. Keep short — every field costs conversions.

form_recipient._note: Email leads go to. ONLY set if the user explicitly gave one; otherwise omit (defaults to the site admin email). NEVER invent.

footer._description: Page footer with brand info, links, and contact details.

options.default: Multi-column dark footer with brand, link columns, and contact. Standard.
options.light: White/light background footer with colored icons. Clean, modern.

social_icons.description: Social media links for the brand.

disclaimer._description: Small disclaimer text at very bottom. Optional.
disclaimer.description: Disclaimer text. Also picks up top-level social_icons for a mini footer row.
disclaimer.example: Results may vary. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

form_embed._description: Embed an EXISTING form built with the site's form plugin (WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity, Ninja, Fluent) inside a styled centered card. The form keeps its plugin's styling and submission handling. form_shortcode must be an exact shortcode from the site's real form list — never invented.

subheadline.example: Fill out the application below and we'll get back to you within 2 business days.

form_shortcode.description: EXACT shortcode of an existing form on this site, e.g. [wpforms id="123" title="false"] or [contact-form-7 id="7" title="Contact form 1"]. Only allowlisted form-plugin shortcodes render.

schedule._description: Agenda/schedule block: conference days, church service times, class schedules, event programs, office hours as a feature. REPEATABLE (schedule, schedule#2...) for multi-day events.

options.default: Time-rail agenda: accent time left, session title + speaker/location/tag meta + desc right, hairline rows, optional day-group headers (items[].day).
options.times: Service-times card grid: clock icon chip, the time as display type, label, optional note. THE church 'when we meet' block; also class times, walk-in hours.
options.tabs: One tab per distinct items[].day (needs 2+ days). Clickable multi-day agenda; stacks to accordion on mobile.

items._note: [{time?: '9:00 AM', title (required), desc?, speaker?, location?, tag?: 'Keynote', day?: 'Day 1 — Friday', duration? }] — only render what's real; omit fields you don't know.

cta._note: {text, url} — e.g. Register button under the agenda.

sticky_bar._description: Mobile sticky call-now bar: fixed to the bottom of the screen ON PHONES ONLY (hidden on desktop). THE conversion pattern for local-service landers — the call button is always one thumb-tap away. Place LAST before footer in sections.

cta._note: {text: 'Call Now', url: 'tel:+18645551234'} — use the REAL phone. Without a cta (or real phone to synthesize one) the bar is skipped.

phone._note: Real phone number; synthesizes the call button when cta omitted.

variant_pairing_guide._description: Recommended variant combinations for visual harmony and contrast.

dark_hero_flow.description: Bold, high-impact pages. Dark hero → light middle → dark CTA.

light_hero_flow.description: Clean, professional pages. Light hero → alternating contrast.

visual_heavy_flow.description: Image-rich pages for visual industries (real estate, hospitality, portfolio).

minimal_flow.description: Clean, text-focused pages for professional services.

saas_tech.tips: Lead with metrics. Use counter animations in stats/results. Include pricing. Gradient hero works well. Features bento makes a modern asymmetric showcase (first item = big tile). cta_final split (with a bullets array of 3-5 reassurances) converts better than a bare gradient bar.

local_service.tips: Include map section. Use local imagery. Feature testimonials prominently. Add contact info in footer.

ecommerce.tips: Product images are critical. Use image_cards features. Gallery for product showcase.

portfolio_creative.tips: Let work speak. Minimal text, maximum imagery. Clean typography.

healthcare_wellness.tips: Trust is paramount. Use team photos, testimonials, and credential badges. Calming colors.

education_courses.tips: Video hero for course preview. Timeline steps for curriculum. Show student results.

restaurant_hospitality.tips: Full-bleed hero image. Food/venue gallery. Map for location. Warm color palette.

nonprofit.tips: Emotional imagery. Impact metrics in results. Strong mission statement in hero.

common_fontawesome_icons._note: Use these proven icons. Always format as 'fas fa-name' (solid) or 'fab fa-name' (brands).
